# Nobody answers, and the proposal is a scale, a risky row. A risky row never runs without an approval, so after the last deadline the desk does not write.
# It pages the commander with the case and holds the incident for a person.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

incidentinit
incidentfakes
subst home/.incident/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env INCIDENT_DIR=$WORK/ops
env INCIDENT_MINUTE_SECONDS=1
env INCIDENT_ROUNDS=2
env INCIDENT_ROUND_SECONDS=1

stdin alert.json
exec sh ops/scripts/spool-alert.sh
exec obeereal item add incident watch-1 --title 'Watch' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run watch-1 incident --workflow ops/workflow.star
stdout 'item watch-1 finished'

# The chain ran to its end.
grep -count=1 '^incident-2 manager$' pages.log
grep -count=1 '^incident-2 commander$' pages.log

# No write, no saved state, no status, no postmortem.
! exists writes.log
! exists status.log
! exists home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/before.json
! exists home/.incident/postmortems/incident-2.md

# The timeline names the reason and the handoff.
grep 'HANDOFF: nobody answered the whole chain, and scale is not a safe mitigation' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
grep -count=1 '^analyst$' calls.log
! grep postmortem calls.log

-- body.txt --
The watch.
